# FG-CI-0026

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `gpu_denied_on_untagged_runner` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI のジョブのサービスが GPU を求めましたが、この Runner には GPU がありません。ジョブは失敗として報告されました。
- en: A service of the CI job asked for the GPU, but this runner has none. The job was reported as failed.
- id: Layanan tugas CI meminta GPU, tetapi runner ini tidak memilikinya. Tugas dilaporkan gagal.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 17 P17-1 (ADR-0029 amendment 2026-11-14): a service with `gpu: true` in `.forge-ci.yml` (only allowed in a job tagged `gpu-eval`) gets the GPU (CDI devices) and the read-only model store from the runner host's `[gpu_eval]` configuration. The job was claimed by a runner without `[gpu_eval]` (`reason=runner_without_gpu`): an administrator gave a runner the `gpu-eval` tag (`forge admin runner` / the runners page) without configuring its host, or the GPU runner's configuration lost the section. A runner tagged `gpu-eval` takes only jobs that ask for the tag, so an untagged job never reaches it; this code means the tag and the host configuration disagree. The job fails before any checkout, pod or container — it never runs without the GPU it asked for (`forge/ai-eval` is then `error`, never a pass).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The runner host (`journalctl -u forge-runner`, JSON) logs it once (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id` and in `context` `job_id`, `attempt`, `pipeline_id`, `project_id`, `reason`; the job's log ends with the same code. Compare the runner's tags (`forge admin runner list`: `runner_id` of the job, SELECT runner_id FROM forge.ci_jobs WHERE id = <job_id>) with its host's `/etc/forge-runner/config.toml` (`[gpu_eval]`).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner (GPU runner): either configure `[gpu_eval]` (CDI devices, model store) on that runner's host and restart it, or remove the `gpu-eval` tag from a runner without a GPU (RunnerManage). Then retry the pipeline (gstn pipeline retry --project <id> <pipeline_id>).
